$comment: Config for the vendored claude-discipline-pack hooks. Update the pack, then run: node ../claude-discipline-pack/bin/discipline.mjs apply --target . (and `check` in CI).
$commentMode: enforce: the gates block. This repo previously enforced its branch rule with a hand-written hook, so shadow would have been a downgrade in protection — and the event log counts intercepts either way, which is the number shadow would have produced. Shadow is for gates you do not yet trust.

notes: epic branch -> develop -> main by merge only; never commit on main
no commit without the user reviewing the diff first

dod.$commentPreconditions: What the checks need in order to mean anything. Most of this suite talks to a real Postgres and a real Azurite, so with the daemon stopped every integration test fails with a connection error and the gate reported that as 'definition-of-done checks failed' — blaming the diff for a stopped daemon. Checked first, reported separately, and it still blocks: unverified is unverified, but the message now says what to start rather than what to fix.

preconditions.name: docker daemon
preconditions.remedy: Start Docker Desktop, then `docker compose up -d` — the integration tests need Postgres and Azurite.
